stories.title: Diocese decision to allow Flintshire taxpayers to fund new school branded ‘unfair’
stories.summary: Opponents of Flintshire’s Catholic super-school plans have reacted with anger after it emerged the Diocese of Wrexham made a financial contribution to a new school in Gwynedd. Flintshire council taxpayers are facing a 50-year bill of more than £30m if plans to close four Catholic Schools in the county to build a 3-18 Catholic super-school

stories.title: Chester Zoo study finds barriers to wildlife friendly gardens in North Wales
stories.summary: Fewer than 40% of people are willing to make their gardens more wildlife friendly, according to a new study by Chester Zoo and Nottingham Trent University. The study surveyed more than 230 householders in Cheshire and North Wales. Just over a third, 38%, said they were willing or able to introduce more wildlife friendly features

stories.title: Deeside pharmaceutical firm named one of UK’s best workplaces in biopharma
stories.summary: A Deeside company that makes products used to diagnose food allergies has been named one of the UK’s Best Workplaces in BioPharma. Reacta Healthcare develops and manufactures pharmaceutical-grade oral food challenge products, which are used in diagnosing food allergies. The recognition, from Great Place To Work UK, was based on anonymous feedback from Reacta Healthcare

stories.title: Cabinet urged to heed public feeling over Saltney primary school merger
stories.summary: Flintshire’s Cabinet has been urged to think carefully after governors, teachers and of parents overwhelmingly opposed plans to merge two Saltney schools. stories.title: Helen Jenner appointed new leader of Reform UK Wales
stories.summary: Helen Jenner MS has been appointed the new leader of Reform UK Wales. The Bangor Conwy Mon Senedd Member, who was previously the Deputy Leader of Reform UK Wales, was elected by her colleagues on Monday morning. Born in Neath and raised in Anglesey, Jenner is a married mother of two and was a teacher
